newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pinault-Printemps jumps on dividend hike.
newsitem.headline: Pinault-Printemps jumps on dividend hike.

text.p: Shares in French retail group Pinault-Printemps-Redoute rose on the Paris bourse after it announced a 30.6 percent net dividend increase to be paid out for the 1996 financial year, to 32 francs per share.
The share was 7.08 percent higher at 2,465 francs at 1019 GMT, and at once stage hit a high of 2,500, close to its year high of 2,515 francs.
The company was also meeting analysts on Thursday after reporting on Wednesday that 1996 net attributable profit rose to 2.065 billion francs from 1.516 billion.
